subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: After rebasing onto current main, should this PR retain the v4-to-v8 Room migration and fail-closed manual-recovery behavior for legacy outbox rows whose original agent owner cannot be proven?
rationale: The safer routing rule prevents cross-chat replay, but it can intentionally stop existing queued or accepted rows and require user re-entry or deletion; tests can prove mechanics but cannot choose that upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve after upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the fail-closed migration, resolve the conflict, and require exact-head migration, Android build, lint, and emulator evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow the persisted-state change
options.body: Land composer isolation first and defer outbox/cache schema changes until a separately reviewed migration and recovery design is ready.

options.title: Preserve legacy replay behavior
options.body: Add an explicitly approved compatibility path for migrated rows, accepting the risk that ambiguous rows may follow a changed default agent.

recommendation.title: Approve after upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed migration, resolve the conflict, and require exact-head migration, Android build, lint, and emulator evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the consolidated ownership and migration expansion and is best positioned to confirm whether its intentional upgrade behavior should ship.
